name: LLM-Oasis
description: LLM-Oasis is the largest resource for training end-to-end factuality evaluators, constructed by extracting claims from Wikipedia, falsifying some, and generating pairs of factual and unfactual texts. It includes human-validated data and a gold standard test set to benchmark factuality evaluation systems, addressing limitations of prior resources.
reputation: A useful factuality-evaluation resource that is notable for its scale and human-validated gold test set, but it is still relatively new and not yet broadly standardized in the community.
notes: Dataset includes human annotations and a gold standard test set; GPT-4o achieves up to 60% accuracy on the task.
